title: Job: I Know That My Redeemer Lives

questions.question: How many times have the friends reproached Job?
questions.explanation: Job 19:3 (ESV): "These ten times you have cast reproach upon me; are you not ashamed to wrong me?"

questions.question: Even if it be true that I have erred, my error remains with whom?
questions.explanation: Job 19:4 (ESV): "And even if it be true that I have erred, my error remains with myself."

questions.question: Who has stripped Job of his glory?
questions.explanation: Job 19:9 (ESV): "He has stripped from me my glory and taken the crown from my head."

questions.question: My kinsfolk have failed, and my close friends have what?
questions.explanation: Job 19:14 (ESV): "My kinsfolk have failed, and my close friends have forgotten me."

questions.question: What famous declaration does Job make?
options: I know that my Redeemer lives
questions.correctAnswer: I know that my Redeemer lives
questions.explanation: Job 19:25 (ESV): "For I know that my Redeemer lives, and at the last he will stand upon the earth."

questions.question: He has put my brothers far from me, and those who knew me are wholly what?
questions.explanation: Job 19:13 (ESV): "He has put my brothers far from me, and those who knew me are wholly estranged from me."

questions.question: My breath is strange to my wife, and I am a stench to whom?
options: The children of my own mother
questions.correctAnswer: The children of my own mother
questions.explanation: Job 19:17 (ESV): "My breath is strange to my wife, and I am a stench to the children of my own mother."

questions.question: Even young children do what?
questions.explanation: Job 19:18 (ESV): "Even young children despise me; when I rise they talk against me."

questions.question: Oh that my words were written! Oh that they were what?
questions.explanation: Job 19:23 (ESV): "Oh that my words were written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!"

questions.question: Job wishes his words were graven in the rock with what?
questions.explanation: Job 19:24 (ESV): "Oh that with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!"

questions.question: After my skin has been thus destroyed, yet in my flesh I shall see whom?
questions.explanation: Job 19:26 (ESV): "and after my skin has been thus destroyed, yet in my flesh I shall see God,"

questions.question: Whom I shall see for myself, and my eyes shall behold, and not what?
questions.explanation: Job 19:27 (ESV): "whom I shall see for myself, and my eyes shall behold, and not another. My heart faints within me!"

questions.question: Be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishment of the sword, that you may know there is a what?
questions.explanation: Job 19:29 (ESV): "...that you may know there is a judgment."

questions.question: I call to my servant, but he gives me no answer; I must plead with him with my what?
questions.explanation: Job 19:16 (ESV): "I call to my servant, but he gives me no answer; I must plead with him with my mouth for mercy."

questions.question: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone, and my hope has he pulled up like a what?
questions.explanation: Job 19:10 (ESV): "He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone, and my hope has he pulled up like a tree."

key_verse_text: For I know that my Redeemer lives, and at the last he will stand upon the earth.
